content: उद्गै €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To sing in a loud tone, sing aloud; उद्गास्यतामिच्छति किन्नराणाम् <ls>Ku. 1. 8</ls>; गेयमुद्गातुकामा <ls>Me. 88</ls>; to sing (in general); उद्गीयमानं वनदेवताभिः <ls>R. 2. 12</ls>; निभृताक्षरमुज्जगे <ls>Śi. 6. 20</ls>. .²2 To begin to sing; त्वं न उद्गायेति तथेति तेभ्योवागुदगायत् <ls>Bṛ. Up. 1. 3. 2</ls>. .²3 To sing or chant (applied to the singing of Sāmaveda); साम सामविदसङ्गमुज्जगौ <ls>Śi. 14. 21</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> उद्गातृ. .²4 To announce, to celebrate in song. .²5 To sing before one (with <ab>acc.</ab>). .²5 To fill or make resonant with song.
